description:
This file defines the internal class RebalancerCompatibleRule which implements multiple interfaces related to cluster imbalance management, rebalancing, and lifecycle events within the Orleans runtime. It manages cluster silo statuses, calculates imbalance tolerances, and reacts to cluster status changes and reports to maintain proper cluster balancing.

Key features include status change tracking, imbalance calculations based on cluster size, and integration with lifecycle and reporting systems.

classes.name: RebalancerCompatibleRule
classes.description: An internal class responsible for managing cluster rebalancing rules based on silo status and imbalance reports, adjusting tolerances dynamically according to cluster size and rebalancer status.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the imbalance is within the tolerated pairwise imbalance threshold.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications of silo status changes, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the object to lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnReport
methods.description: Processes imbalance reports, updating cluster imbalance metrics.

methods.name: UpdatePairwiseImbalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the pairwise imbalance threshold based on current cluster status.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method to start subscribing to status and report events.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method to unsubscribe from status and report events.
